NBA DFS Picks for Saturday, November 28 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Saturday, November 28 · 5 games · First game 5:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 28, 10:31 AM ET

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is the top-projected player on the Saturday, November 28 DraftKings main slate at 51.6 DraftKings points for $10,500. Franz Wagner (ORL, 47.9, $9,300) and Alperen Sengun (HOU, 46.4, $9,600) are next.

Anfernee Simons (PHI) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.58 projected points per $1,000 at $4,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 28, 10:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
